author: Putra, Fadhlurrahman, et al.

steps.title: Describe Morbidity Rate and Predictors
steps.instruction: Describe the morbidity rate in North Sumatra and its associated predictors.

steps.title: Analyze Relationship Patterns
steps.instruction: Create scatterplots between the morbidity rate and each predictor to determine the relationship pattern.

steps.title: Perform Spatial Heterogeneity Tests
steps.instruction: Conduct spatial heterogeneity tests using the Breusch-Pagan method.

steps.title: Calculate Euclidean Distance
steps.instruction: Calculate the Euclidean distance between the i-th location (ui, vi) and the j-th location (uj, vj).

steps.title: Determine Optimal Kernel Weighting
steps.instruction: Determine the best weighting of the kernel functions based on the minimum Generalized Cross-Validation (GCV) value.

steps.title: Select Optimum Knot Point
steps.instruction: Choose the optimum knot point based on the minimum GCV value.

steps.title: Estimate GWTSNR Model Parameters
steps.instruction: Determine the parameter estimates β˜(ui, vi) and δ˜(ui, vi) from the GWTSNR model using Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE).

substeps.instruction: Determine the probability density function of yi: f(yi)=1/(2πσ²)exp(−1/(2σ²)[yi−(β0(ui,vi)+∑p=1l∑k=1mβpk(ui,vi)xpik+∑p=1l∑h=1rδp,m+h(ui,vi)(xpi−Kph)+m)]²)
Establish the likelihood function L(β˜(ui,vi),δ˜(ui,vi),σ²|Y˜) = ∏i=1n f(yi|β˜(ui,vi),δ˜(ui,vi),σ²)
Establish the weighted likelihood function at the j-th location using weighting value wi(j) for the i-th location to the j-location

Calculate the natural logarithm (ln) of the weighted likelihood function: lnL(β˜(uj,vj),δ˜(uj,vj),σ²|Y˜) = −n/2(ln(2π)+ln(σ²)) − 1/(2σ²)Ψ, where Ψ = (Y˜−Xβ˜(uj,vj)−Pδ˜(uj,vj))′W(uj,vj)(Y˜−Xβ˜(uj,vj)−Pδ˜(uj,vj))
Maximize ln L to obtain estimators β˜^(uj,vj) and δ˜^(uj,vj)

Calculate the independent estimator β˜^(ui,vi) using the formula: β˜^(ui,vi) = S(X′W(ui,vi)X)⁻¹[X′−X′W(ui,vi)P(P′W(ui,vi)P)⁻¹P′]W(ui,vi)Y˜, where S = [I−(X′W(ui,vi)X)⁻¹X′W(ui,vi)P(P′W(uj,vj)P)⁻¹P′W(ui,vi)X]⁻¹

Calculate the independent estimator δ˜^(ui,vi) using the formula: δ˜^(ui,vi) = R(P′W(ui,vi)P)⁻¹[P′−P′W(ui,vi)X(X′W(ui,vi)X)⁻¹X′]W(ui,vi)Y˜, where R = [I−(P′W(ui,vi)P)⁻¹P′W(ui,vi)X(X′W(ui,vi)X)⁻¹X′W(ui,vi)P]⁻¹

steps.title: Finalize GWTSNR Model
steps.instruction: Obtain the best GWTSNR model based on the calculated estimations.

steps.title: Test Model Fit Hypothesis
steps.instruction: Test the fit model hypothesis by comparing the GWTSNR model and the TSNR model.

steps.title: Perform Parameter Significance Tests
steps.instruction: Determine parameter significance tests both simultaneously and partially.

steps.title: Interpret and Map Results
steps.instruction: Interpret the GWTSNR model and map the 33 districts/cities in North Sumatra based on significant predictor variables.
